verses.sourceText: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

verses.sourceText: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

verses.sourceText: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

verses.sourceText: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

verses.sourceText: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

verses.sourceText: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

verses.sourceText: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

verses.sourceText: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

verses.sourceText: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

verses.sourceText: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

verses.sourceText: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

verses.sourceText: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.sourceText: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
verses.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文と同節および直前の照応を照合。既存リンクに明白な対象取り違えは見つからず、提案変更なし。

verses.sourceText: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
verses.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文と同節および直前の照応を照合。既存リンクに明白な対象取り違えは見つからず、提案変更なし。

verses.sourceText: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
verses.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文と同節および直前の照応を照合。既存リンクに明白な対象取り違えは見つからず、提案変更なし。

verses.sourceText: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

verses.sourceText: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

verses.sourceText: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文と同節および直前の照応を照合。既存リンクに明白な対象取り違えは見つからず、提案変更なし。

verses.sourceText: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

verses.sourceText: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

verses.sourceText: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

verses.sourceText: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

verses.sourceText: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

verses.sourceText: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

verses.sourceText: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.sourceText: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

verses.sourceText: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

verses.sourceText: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

verses.sourceText: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

verses.sourceText: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

verses.sourceText: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

verses.sourceText: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.sourceText: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

verses.sourceText: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

verses.sourceText: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

verses.sourceText: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

verses.sourceText: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

verses.sourceText: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

verses.sourceText: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

verses.sourceText: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

verses.sourceText: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

verses.sourceText: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.sourceText: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

verses.sourceText: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
verses.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文と同節および直前の照応を照合。既存リンクに明白な対象取り違えは見つからず、提案変更なし。

verses.sourceText: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

verses.sourceText: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

verses.sourceText: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

verses.sourceText: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

verses.sourceText: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

verses.sourceText: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

verses.sourceText: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
